description: Cancel a charge added by mistake (get its id from get_booking's charges). It's kept on record as voided, with the reason. Anything already paid above the new total is to be given back. Without confirm: true it only shows which charge would be removed.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually remove it

reason.description: Why, e.g. 'Charged to the wrong room'

name: void_charge
title: Remove a charge from a stay
